intro: Essential information regarding your stay, access requirements, and our commitment to the local community.

sidebar.label: On this page
sidebar.quote: "Our rules exist to ensure the harmony of village life and the comfort of all our guests."

access.heading: Access & Mobility
access.terrain: All properties are traditional stone houses in historic hillside villages. The terrain consists of uneven cobblestones, stepped lanes, and sloped paths. None of the properties are step-free, and they are not suitable for wheelchair access.
access.quirks: Each home has unique architectural quirks. For example, some bedrooms are accessed via external stone stairs, while others feature traditional sunken entrances.

checkInOut.heading: Arrival & Departure
checkInOut.note: Early arrivals and late departures are subject to availability and cleaning schedules.

pets.title: Pet Policy
pets.text: {pets}. Please coordinate with us prior to booking. A professional cleaning fee may apply to ensure the house is pristine for the next guest.

wifi.title: Connectivity
wifi.text: {wifi}. While we provide high-speed access, the thick stone walls may limit signal on outdoor terraces.

quiet-hours.title: Quiet Hours
quiet-hours.text: Quiet hours are observed from {quietHours}. We ask that you respect our local neighbors by keeping terrace noise and music to a minimum after 23:00.

smoking.title: Smoking
smoking.text: In accordance with health and fire safety regulations, smoking is strictly prohibited inside the properties. It is permitted on outdoor terraces; please ensure all materials are extinguished safely due to summer fire risks.
